# MTP Frontend

A Next.js 16 frontend for the MTP Developer Platform, a marketing and documentation site for the Model Tool Protocol.

MTP is presented here as an agent orchestration framework that separates model reasoning from environment execution. The site explains structured execution plans, tool dependency resolution, policy enforcement, provider adapters, persistence, and transport layers.

## What This Site Contains

- A polished landing page that introduces MTP and drives users into docs and product views
- A documentation system with a sidebar, category grouping, and dynamic slug-based pages
- A dashboard view showing mock provider health and runtime metrics
- An execution visualizer that illustrates plan planning and branching
- A playground that simulates tool selection and agent interaction
- Shared navigation and UI primitives used across the app

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 16
- React 19
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS 4
- Framer Motion
- lucide-react
- clsx
- tailwind-merge

## Routes

### Public routes
- `/` - Marketing landing page
- `/docs` - Redirects to the introduction page
- `/docs/[slug]` - Dynamic documentation pages

### App routes
- `/dashboard` - System dashboard with provider health cards
- `/execution` - Execution flow visualizer
- `/playground` - Interactive agent playground mockup

## Documentation Sections

The docs navigation is organized into these groups:

- Getting Started
- Core Concepts
- Tools
- Features
- Advanced
- Cookbook
- Reference

Example doc pages include:

- Introduction
- Quickstart
- Installation
- Agents
- Execution Plans
- Runtime Engine
- Tool Registry
- Built-in Toolkits
- Creating Tools
- MCP Tools
- Multi-Model Support
- Policies and Safety
- Persistence
- Streaming and Events
- Transport Layer
- Autoresearch Mode
- CLI Reference
- Agent API
- Protocol Spec
- Architecture

## Site Behavior

- The landing page uses a dark visual style with animated background particles and motion-based section reveals.
- Docs pages render structured content blocks such as text, code samples, lists, callouts, and tables.
- Docs also include a floating mini-navigation that tracks headings in the current article.
- The dashboard and execution views are currently UI demos with static data.
- The playground is a mock interaction surface for tool-enabled agents.

## Project Structure

```text
app/
  page.tsx
  layout.tsx
  globals.css
  docs/
    page.tsx
    layout.tsx
    [slug]/page.tsx
  (app)/
    layout.tsx
    dashboard/page.tsx
    execution/page.tsx
    playground/page.tsx

components/
  AnimatedCard.tsx
  BubbleBackground.tsx
  CodeBlock.tsx
  MarketingNavbar.tsx
  Navbar.tsx
  Sidebar.tsx

lib/
  docs-content.ts
  utils.ts
```

## Key Files

- `app/page.tsx` - Landing page
- `app/docs/layout.tsx` - Docs shell with sidebar and top nav
- `app/docs/[slug]/page.tsx` - Dynamic docs renderer
- `lib/docs-content.ts` - Docs sidebar structure and page content
- `components/CodeBlock.tsx` - Syntax-highlighted code block renderer
- `components/BubbleBackground.tsx` - Animated landing page background
- `components/AnimatedCard.tsx` - Motion-powered card wrapper
- `components/Navbar.tsx` - App navigation
- `components/MarketingNavbar.tsx` - Landing page navigation

## Getting Started

### Install dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

### Run the development server

```bash
npm run dev
```

### Build for production

```bash
npm run build
```

### Start the production server

```bash
npm run start
```

### Lint the project

```bash
npm run lint
```

## Development Notes

- The project uses the Next.js App Router.
- Global styling and design tokens live in `app/globals.css`.
- Fonts are loaded through `next/font/google`.
- Tailwind CSS utility classes are used throughout the UI.
- The docs content is data-driven from `lib/docs-content.ts`.
- Some navigation links currently point to UI surfaces that are not implemented in this repo, such as `/support`.

## Repository Purpose

This repository is a frontend presentation layer for MTP. It is meant to communicate the product narrative, surface docs, and present a coherent interface for the protocol and its tooling ecosystem.

## License

No license file is present in this repository.
```
